## Ymaze Forced Alternation Test (YmazeFA)

### Experimental conditions

2 Cohorts of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\analysis\ymaze FA`  

Preprocessed Data: 
 
2 Cohorts:  

`FA_data_cohort1_2025-06-13.xlsx`    
`FA_data_cohort2_2025-06-13.xlsx`   

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\ymaze FA`    

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used. 

```{r data_loading}

# Empty global environment
rm(list = ls())

### 1.0 LOAD IN DATA ----------------------------------------------------------
# load data
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/analysis/ymaze FA/"

raw_data_file_c1 <- "FA_data_cohort1_2025-06-13.xlsx"
raw_data_file_c2 <- "FA_data_cohort2_2025-06-13.xlsx"

data_c1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c1,sep=""))
data_c2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c2,sep=""))

# combine all groups to create a single data frame 
raw_data <- rbind(data_c1, data_c2)

# # combine all groups to create a single data frame 
# raw_data <- rbind(data_pm, data_wt)
# raw_data <- raw_data %>% 
#   mutate(animal_no = as.numeric(animal_no))

#####
# lookup
file_path_lookup <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/ymaze FA/"

# load lookup data files
lookup_file <- "lookup_ns.xlsx"

#########
# read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lookup,lookup_file,sep=""))
names(lookup)[names(lookup) == 'Animal ID'] <- 'animal_no'

lookup <- lookup %>% 
  mutate(animal_no = as.character(animal_no),
         cohort = as.character(cohort)) 

# combine data with lookup
data <- full_join(raw_data,lookup, by= "animal_no")

# get list of groups without NAs
list_of_groups <- sort(na.omit(unique(data$Group)), decreasing = T)

# select columns of interest
data <- data %>%
  rename(group = Group,
         Arm_3 = `Arm 3 (left, Righ)`) %>%
  dplyr::select(no, animal_no, group, cohort, Arm_3, `Correct choice in first attempt`, Sex, contains("Tracklength"), contains("Track length"), contains("Visits"), contains("Visit"), contains("Duration")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = list_of_groups))

#####

#lapply(data,class)
#names(data)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(#group = factor(group),
         cohort = factor(cohort),
         gender = factor(Sex)) %>%
  mutate_at(c(6,8:24),as.numeric)

```

\newpage

### Results

#### Correct choice in first attempt

```{r fig1, fig.align = "left", fig.width=9, fig.height=5}

# data fig1
data_f1 = data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  mutate(correct_entry = 1*`Correct choice in first attempt`) %>%
  mutate(correct_entry = as.factor(correct_entry))

################################# 

# stats fig1a
#stat_1a <- data_f1 %>%
#  filter(correct_entry == 1) %>%
#  count(correct_entry, group) %>%
##  mutate(group = as.factor(group)) %>%
#  wilcox_test(n ~ group) %>%
#  add_significance("p")

# plot fig1a
pl_1a = data_f1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group, fill=correct_entry)) +
  geom_bar(position="dodge") + 
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,9)) +
  labs(title="Correct first attempt", x="", y = "Counts") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  geom_text(stat='count', 
            aes(label=after_stat(count)), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9),
            vjust = -0.08) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) #+
#  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02) 

#pl_1a  

################################# 
 
# stats fig1b
stat_1b <- data_f1 %>%
  group_by(group,correct_entry) %>%
  count(correct_entry, group, gender) %>%  
  wilcox_test(n ~ gender) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "correct_entry")  # needs to be included

# stat_1b <- stat_1b %>%
#   # shift positions slightly for p-value labels
#   mutate(
#     xmin =  1, 
#     xmax =  2   
#   )

# plot fig1b
pl_1b = data_f1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=correct_entry, fill=gender)) +
  geom_bar(position="dodge") + 
#  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +  
  facet_grid (~group) +   
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,7)) +
  labs(title="Correct first attempt", x="", y = "Counts") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  geom_text(stat='count', 
            aes(label=after_stat(count)), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9),
            vjust = -0.08) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +   
#  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)
  geom_segment(data = stat_1b,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y.position, yend = y.position),
               color = "black", size = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) + 
  # left vertical handle
  geom_segment(data = stat_1b,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y.position, yend = y.position - 0.2),
               color = "black", size = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # right vertical handle
  geom_segment(data = stat_1b,
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y.position, yend = y.position - 0.2),
               color = "black", size = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +  
  geom_text(data = stat_1b,
            aes(x = xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2,  # Position in the middle of the group comparison
                y = y.position+0.3,
                label = p.signif),
            # color = "red",
            # size = 5,
            # fontface = "italic",
            inherit.aes = FALSE)

#pl_1b  

################################# 

#arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_1a, pl_1b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Correct choice in first attempt during novel phase between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).

__Statistics for Figure 1 B (between gender)__

```{r stat1b, echo=F}

#create a tibble to collect all stats

stat_1b %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-x,-xmin,-xmax) %>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))
```

#### Time spent exploring during novel phase

```{r fig2, fig.align = "left", fig.width=12, fig.height=5}

# data fig2
data_f2 <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(`Duration (s) arm 1`,`Duration (s) arm 2`,`Duration (s) arm 3`,group,no,gender) %>%
  rename("arm_1" = `Duration (s) arm 1`,
         "arm_2" = `Duration (s) arm 2`,
         "arm_3" = `Duration (s) arm 3`) %>%
  mutate(arm_1 = as.numeric(arm_1),
         arm_2 = as.numeric(arm_2),
         arm_3 = as.numeric(arm_3)) %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  gather(key = "Sides", value = "Dur", -group, -no, -gender) 

################################# 
# stat fig2a
stat_2a <- data_f2 %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Dur ~ Sides, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")

# plot fig2a
fig2a <- ggplot(data_f2, aes(x = Sides, y = Dur, color = Sides)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,225)) +
  labs(title="Time spent exploring during noval phase", x="", y = "Duration (s)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +  
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("arm_1", "arm_2"), c("arm_1", "arm_3"), c("arm_2", "arm_3")),
    data = data_f2,  # pass data here without repeating it in the aes()
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    color = "black") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#fig2a

################################# 
# stat fig2b
stat_2b <- data_f2 %>%
  group_by(group, Sides) %>%
  wilcox_test(Dur ~ gender) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%  
  add_xy_position(x = "Sides")  # needs to be included 

# plot fig2b
pl_2b <- ggplot(data_f2, aes(x = Sides, y = Dur, color = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,225)) +
  labs(title="Time spent exploring during noval phase", x="", y = "Duration (s)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_2b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_2b

# stat_2b <- stat_2b %>%
#   add_xy_position(x = "Sides")  
# 
# fig2b <- pl_2b +
#   stat_pvalue_manual(stat_2b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#fig2b

################################# 
# arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig2 <- ggarrange(fig2a, pl_2b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig2

```

#### No. of visits to arm 2 and 3 during novel phase

```{r fig3, fig.align = "left", fig.width=12, fig.height=5}

# data fig3
data_f3 <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(`Visits arm 2`,`Visits arm 3`,group,no,gender) %>%
  rename("visits_2" = `Visits arm 2`,
         "visits_3" = `Visits arm 3`) %>%
  mutate("visits_2" = as.numeric(visits_2),
         "visits_3" = as.numeric(visits_3)) %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  gather(key = "arms", value = "visits", -group, -no, -gender)  

################################# 
# stat fig3a
stat_3a <- data_f3 %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(visits ~ arms,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%  
  add_xy_position(x = "arms")  # needs to be included  

# plot fig3a
fig3a <- ggplot(data_f3, aes(x = arms, y = visits, color = arms)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,14)) +
  labs(title="Number of visits", x="", y = "Visits count") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  # geom_signif(
  #   comparisons = list(c("visits_2", "visits_3")),
  #   data = data_f3,  # pass data here without repeating it in the aes()
  #   map_signif_level = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_3a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#fig3a

################################# 
# stat fig3b
stat_3b <- data_f3 %>%
  group_by(group,arms) %>%
  wilcox_test(visits ~ gender,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%  
  add_xy_position(x = "arms")  # needs to be included 
 
# plot fig3b
pl_3b <- ggplot(data_f3, aes(x = arms, y = visits, color = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,14)) +
  labs(title="Number of visits", x="", y = "Visits count") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_3b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_3b

################################# 
# arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig3 <- ggarrange(fig3a, pl_3b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig3

```

```{r fig5, fig.align = "left", fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
fig5b <- ggplot(data_f5, aes(x = group, y = visits, color = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
#  facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.5), size = 1.5) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,14)) +
  labs(title="Number of visits to arm 3", x="", y = "Visits count") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +    
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_5b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#fig5b

################################# 
# arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig5 <- ggarrange(fig5a, fig5b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig5

```

__Figure 5.__ Number of visits to the arm 3 during noval phase between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).

```{r stat5a, echo=F}
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))
```
